findings: EmailFunction constructs and sends HTML email/attachment; no content equality or explicit disposal of message/client/attachment in source. No email sent during review.
excelping invokes ping for each input hostname and reports exit status to Excel; no duplicate handling.
printersreport exports AD printQueue metadata using an externally supplied Write-Log function; not file deduplication.

BulkRestoreOnedriveFiles filters recycle-bin deletion timestamps inclusively and restores each ID. Date-only upper bound parses at midnight, rather than covering the entire final calendar day. No duplicate-content confirmation.

itemslevelperm adds a role only when the user has no assignment; an existing user assignment without the requested role has no update branch. It operates only on items already having unique assignments.

ConvertCSV2XL converts/formats through Excel COM. The source refers to plural $Workbooks while assigning singular $Workbook; column count is obtained from imported row properties, so header-only CSV lacks row-derived columns. No Excel runtime proof.

limits: Static source review only; no email, ping, AD, SharePoint, OneDrive restoration or Excel operations executed.
